subject: Remove duplicate clientsCronTcpIsClosing() call in clientsCron (#4752)
reason: The change deletes a redundant second call to clientsCronTcpIsClosing() in clientsCron(); the same function is still called first in the per-client check chain (server.c:1301), and none of the checks between the two call sites (query/output buffer resize, expensive-client tracking) can change the connection's read/write handlers or closing state, so the removed call was unreachable-effect dead code. No reply, data, replication, or connection-cleanup behavior differs between the builds, so no scenario can exercise a behavioral difference.
